description: Peer-coupled npm package families that must share one Dependabot group (mergepath#2162). Dependabot assigns each update to the first group it matches; when members of one family land in different groups, each PR bumps one half of a peer-coupled pair and fails npm ci. Read by scripts/ci/dependabot_coupled_groups.py.

families.rationale: @firebase/rules-unit-testing peers on the matching firebase major, and firebase is a production dependency while the test harness is a dev dependency.
families.evidence: 2026-10-13: firebase 13 and @firebase/rules-unit-testing 6 split across five repos (friends-and-family-billing#491/#490 and siblings).

families.rationale: firebase-functions caps its firebase-admin peer range, and firebase-functions-test peers on both; the test package is a dev dependency.
families.evidence: friends-and-family-billing /functions and fiveacross hold firebase-admin majors by hand behind the firebase-functions cap.

families.rationale: @eslint/js peers on the matching eslint major.
families.evidence: friends-and-family-billing#475 bumped @eslint/js to 10 while eslint stayed on 9; held by #477.

families.rationale: typescript-eslint caps its typescript peer range.
families.evidence: matchline, overridebroadway, tadlockpsychiatry and nathanpaynedotcom hold typescript majors behind the typescript-eslint peer ceiling.

families.rationale: vitest, @vitejs/plugin-react and vite-plugin-pwa peer on the vite major.
families.evidence: fiveacross holds vite, vitest, @vitejs/plugin-react and vite-plugin-pwa majors together by hand.
